decisions.reason: As a newly launched product highlighted on the home page, it carries visible commitment and recent investment, so management is likely to give it more time rather than withdraw it quickly.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid was publicly featured at launch and fits the firm's traditional wooden seasonal range, which encourages management to persist despite any early uncertainty.
The electronic music box appears to be a prominent innovation shown on the home page, making it strategically important and therefore unlikely to be dropped after only one season.
Although it was only mentioned on the website rather than prominently featured, it supports the electronic music box platform and so benefits from the firm's commitment to that product line.

This Christmas motif platform is a less visible accessory product, but because it complements the music box system and was only just introduced, management would still be inclined to continue it for now.
The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid was shown on the home page and matches the firm's established craft identity, so escalation of commitment makes a near-term withdrawal unlikely.
